finding: Popularized attribution to Peter Drucker is stronger than any coinage claim; the earliest verified breakfast wording located is a March 2000 Giga Information Group headline cited in a September 2000 trade journal.
searchScope: English-language open web, Quote Investigator dossier, newspaper databases cited therein, and secondary management press. Did not inspect a physical March 2000 Giga Information Group original.
evidenceReviewed: Quote Investigator (2017) with hardcopy-verified September 2000 PIMA citation; 2006 Associated Press coverage of Mark Fields; 2011 textbook Drucker attribution.

assertions.subject: March 2000 Giga Information Group headline, as cited September 2000
assertions.publicStatement: Earliest verified occurrence located: a September 2000 PIMA trade-journal article quotes a March 2000 Giga Information Group headline, ΓÇ£Culture Eats Strategy for Breakfast!ΓÇ¥
assertions.caveat: The March 2000 Giga periodical itself was not inspected in this review; the claim rests on the hardcopy-verified September 2000 citation reported by Quote Investigator.

assertions.subject: Peter Drucker
assertions.publicStatement: Current evidence does not securely support coinage by Peter Drucker; his name appears attached to the saying years after the earliest located uses, including after his 2005 death.

assertions.subject: Corporate and management press, including Mark Fields / Ford coverage
assertions.publicStatement: Popularized by management practice and press: by 2006 the slogan appears as a favorite of Ford executive Mark Fields, and later management writing often recycles a Drucker credit.

assertions.subject: Named coinage
assertions.publicStatement: The record remains contested as to a named coiner; the March 2000 Giga headline author is not identified in the sources reviewed.
